name: Airwave
summary: Pick a country code, type your mobile number, and a radio tower texts you a 6-digit code
about: A two-step phone sign-in in emerald and saffron, drawn over a little skyline with a radio mast. A searchable country picker sets the dial code and the number formats itself as you type, with a tick once it is valid. Send code flies your number to the tower, which pings and drops an envelope on the phone, then the 6-digit step checks the code with a resend countdown.
how: Press the country button to search and pick a dial code; arrow keys, Enter and Escape work in the list
Type your number (a leading 0 or a pasted +92 is handled) and press Send code once the tick shows
Read the demo code in the message that drops in and type or paste it into the boxes
Backspace and the arrow keys move between boxes; Edit number goes back to step one
When the countdown ends you can send a new code, up to three times
